evals.prompt: How should I declare variables in modern JavaScript?
evals.expected_output: const default. let if needed. No var. Block scope only.

evals.prompt: How do I safely access nested object properties if some of them might be missing?
evals.expected_output: Optional Chain ?., Nullish Coalescing ??. No manual undefined checks. Intention-revealing naming.

assertions.description: Checks the task contract includes Optional Chain

evals.prompt: How do I handle asynchronous code in modern JavaScript?
evals.expected_output: async/await + try/catch. Prefer native Promise APIs; use util.promisify only for callback APIs that lack a native promise version (one-shot error-first callbacks), and bind receiver methods. Do not blanket-promisify. Preserve the existing module loader: .cjs stays CommonJS, .mjs uses ESM.

evals.prompt: A shared library still ships a .cjs file that several CommonJS services require. Can I convert it to ESM import/export while I'm in there?
evals.expected_output: No implicit migration. Preserve the .cjs/CommonJS loader and its exported shape unless every consumer can load ESM; treat conversion as an explicit, separately verified migration. New modules may use ESM when the package type and Node floor allow it.
